topic: Com alta de 74% em 16 anos, eleitorado idoso ganha força, mas enfrenta desafio da abstenção Notícia Preta Brasil
insights: The elderly electorate in Brazil has increased by 74% over the past 16 years, now representing 23% of the total voter base.
There are over 36.8 million elderly voters in Brazil, marking the largest elderly electorate ever recorded.
Despite the growth in numbers, elderly voters face significant challenges with high abstention rates, necessitating targeted mobilization efforts.
